title: When life starts feeling aimless after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The day fills up, but the inner reason for being here feels thin. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru frames human life as opportunity for meeting, service, and Naam rather than mere maintenance. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Use this life for meeting, not merely for managing. Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift.
actionPrompt: Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
